target: Final verification gate for the cost-profile redesign series. Runs the full RTE regression suite, the promptset v3 audit, a bounded-lane dry-run (Phase A step A2 with --cost-profile value-default --print-config), and a pal/codereview + pal/precommit pass over the cumulative diff E1..E9. Produces a single PROOF bundle that either signs off the series as ready for live operator use or records NOT_VERIFIED evidence and follow-up routing.
invariants: Do not modify any production code in this packet. Verification only.
If verification fails, file a follow-up TP rather than 'fixing in place' — preserves the audit-trail boundary between implementation packets and the verification gate.
The bounded-lane dry-run must NOT use --execute (we're verifying config resolution, not running LLMs). RTE_DISABLE_LIVE_LLM_IN_TESTS=1 stays set.
PAL chain MUST include analyze + thinkdeep + challenge + codereview + precommit + challenge (the long form, because this is the series-final gate).

Verification proof must record exact git SHAs of each contributing packet's merge commit and the cumulative diff range so a future operator can reproduce the verification at the same point in history.
Preserve Dopemux split authority boundaries per AGENTS.md §6.

pr.title: verify(rte): cost-profile redesign series final verification (F)
pr.body:
## Summary
- Series-final verification evidence for the RTE cost-profile redesign (E1..E9).
- Verification is NOT_VERIFIED: the full RTE test suite failed on the post-E9 base, so this PR preserves failed gate evidence rather than claiming readiness.
- Scope is proof-only; no production code changes.

## Validation
- FAIL: full RTE suite under RTE_DISABLE_LIVE_LLM_IN_TESTS=1 exited 1 with 26 failed, 1323 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed.
- PASS: promptset v3 audit returned 0 failures with 136 steps and 6 overrides.
- PASS_WITH_FINDING: bounded --cost-profile value-default --print-config exited 0 but did not emit a cost_profile field, so the packet is not a live-readiness sign-off.
- PAL codereview/precommit transcripts are captured in proof.

## NOT_RUN
- Live LLM execution.
- Provider/account validation.
- In-place production fixes; follow-up packets own remediation.

## Residual Risks / UNKNOWNs
- Cost-profile/routing contract drift remains unresolved across multiple full-suite failures.
- xAI batch support remains unverified (separate TP-RTE-COSTPROFILE-XAI-BATCH-VERIFY-001 covers).
- Post-step output validators for control_plane / security_sensitive steps remain deferred (separate TP-RTE-COSTPROFILE-OUTPUT-VALIDATORS-001 covers).

@codex review

steps.task: Preflight: verify all prerequisite packets (E3, E4-FINISH, E7, E8, E9 plus E9 prerequisite fixes) merged or are present in the normalized stacked base. Capture each merge commit SHA and ancestor status. Verify worktree state and that the branch is based on origin/claude/goofy-haibt-fc568e post-E9 merge.
validation: All 5 packet merge SHAs captured.
Verification branch based on the post-E9 origin/claude/goofy-haibt-fc568e.

steps.task: Run the full RTE test suite under RTE_DISABLE_LIVE_LLM_IN_TESTS=1. Capture stdout/stderr to pytest_full_run.txt.
validation: Pytest exit code captured. Exit code 0 is required for VERIFIED; nonzero result requires NOT_VERIFIED plus explicit failure inventory in SERIES_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md.
Total test count > 800 (sanity check on collection).

steps.task: Run the promptset v3 audit against the new model_map.yaml v3 through runtime code. Capture output. The audit must verify: impact_class enforcement (structural/security_sensitive maps to critical capability_tier); tag enum membership (used tags are a subset of the 8 allowed); tag_rationale presence for every tagged step; override count <= 15.
commands: python -c "import sys,yaml; from pathlib import Path; sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()/'services'/'repo-truth-extractor')); import rte_promptset; p=Path('services/repo-truth-extractor/promptsets/v4/model_map.yaml'); failures=rte_promptset.audit_model_map_v3(yaml.safe_load(p.read_text())); print(f'failure_count={len(failures)}'); raise SystemExit(1 if failures else 0)" 2>&1 | tee proof/rte-cost-profile-redesign/TP-RTE-COSTPROFILE-F-VERIFY-001/promptset_audit_v3.txt
validation: Audit reports 0 lint failures.
Override count is 6 (the consensus-mandated set: Z0/C10/S12/T0/T1/T3).

steps.task: Run the bounded-lane config probe: `RTE_DISABLE_LIVE_LLM_IN_TESTS=1 python services/repo-truth-extractor/run_extraction_v5.py --phase A --step A2 --run-id f_verify_print_config --output-root /tmp/rte-f-verify-print-config --cost-profile value-default --print-config`. Capture output. Verify the resolved ladder evidence for Phase A and record whether the emitted config exposes the requested cost_profile.
commands: RTE_DISABLE_LIVE_LLM_IN_TESTS=1 python services/repo-truth-extractor/run_extraction_v5.py --phase A --step A2 --run-id f_verify_print_config --output-root /tmp/rte-f-verify-print-config --cost-profile value-default --print-config 2>&1 | tee proof/rte-cost-profile-redesign/TP-RTE-COSTPROFILE-F-VERIFY-001/bounded_lane_print_config.txt
validation: --print-config exits 0.
SERIES_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md records whether output contains an emitted cost_profile field; absence is NOT_VERIFIED evidence.
Output contains 'openrouter/openai/gpt-5.3-codex' as the primary route for an A0/A1-class step (CE/medium).
Output does NOT contain any legacy `BALANCED_GROK_OPENROUTER_*` constant references (those are deprecated by E7).

steps.task: Run pal/codereview over the cumulative diff range (series base..origin/claude/goofy-haibt-fc568e post-E9). Capture output.
validation: pal/codereview reports no critical issues OR all critical issues are explicitly addressed in subsequent packets in this series.
Findings classified by severity in SERIES_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md.

steps.task: Run pal/precommit on the verification branch (cumulative work). Capture output.
validation: pal/precommit returns SAFE TO COMMIT or only-info-level findings.

steps.task: Author SERIES_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md: summary of what was verified, packet-by-packet SHAs and ancestor status, test counts (pass/fail/skip), promptset audit results, bounded-lane config summary, pal/codereview verdict, pal/precommit verdict, residual risks, and follow-up routing. Do not recommend live --execute unless status is VERIFIED.
validation: Report explicitly states VERIFIED or NOT_VERIFIED.
If NOT_VERIFIED, names the follow-up TP needed.

steps.task: Emit PROOF.json + sha256sums.txt referencing all the captured artifacts.
validation: PROOF.json parses.
sha256sums.txt verifies all .txt + .md proof files.

steps.task: Commit allowlisted files; push; open PR (no code change PR; verification proof bundle only).
validation: PR title clearly marks 'verify(rte)' scope.
PR body links the SERIES_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md.

steps.task: Update task-packets/INDEX.md to mark E9 merged and this packet as NOT_VERIFIED/Active. Preserve related-ADR column pointing to docs/90-adr/rte-cost-profiles-and-optimizer-wiring.md.
validation: INDEX.md committed in this same PR.
Series packets visible with truthful status updates.
